name: tilcai-mcp
description: MCP server: lets an EVM agent pay USDC to a Stellar address through tilcai-infrastructure (CCTP V2, Avalanche Fuji -> Stellar Testnet, or Avalanche C-Chain -> Stellar Public Network with TILCAI_NETWORK=mainnet)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/main.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

author: Saul Choque <saulchoque123@gmail.com>
